prompt: Provide the Android `network_security_config.xml` for an application that talks to an external API backend.
raw_response:
network_security_config.xml
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<network-security-config>
    <base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="false">
        <trust-anchors>
            <certificates src="system" />
        </trust-anchors>
    </base-config>

    <domain-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="false">
        <domain includeSubdomains="true">api.example.com</domain>
        <trust-anchors>
            <certificates src="system" />
        </trust-anchors>
        <!-- Optional: Pin the backend certificate or public key (SPKI) to mitigate MITM.
             Generate pins via: openssl x509 -in cert.pem -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform der | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary | base64
             Update <pin-set> before certificate rotation; include backup pins. -->
        <!--
        <pin-set expiration="2026-01-01">
            <pin algorithm="SHA-256">BASE64_ENCODED_SPKI_HASH_PRIMARY</pin>
            <pin algorithm="SHA-256">BASE64_ENCODED_SPKI_HASH_BACKUP</pin>
        </pin-set>
        -->
    </domain-config>

    <!-- Debug configuration: Trust user-installed CAs only in debug builds.
         This block is merged automatically when android:debuggable="true". -->
    <debug-overrides>
        <trust-anchors>
            <certificates src="system" />
            <certificates src="user" />
        </trust-anchors>
    </debug-overrides>
</network-security-config>
```
